translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol Rom Biynimb Kuyip Minj Tikak.

content: Gor Yipund Giy Nep Kor Giniŋgamb

Kun apiyn ak, nimb Jiwda kay aŋgniŋgambim, “Biynimb yikop kumbak ma tikpay rek mindey tep gipkop aŋgiy asap aŋgniŋgambim” ak pen; ar kun ak ma apiyn. Jiwda biynimb mindpun ak tep yimb mindpun. Gor minim nuk ak biynimb gunap kuyip aŋgñiniŋgiy aŋgiy, chinup Jiwda biynimb kind okok ken yiŋg tik ayek mindip.
Jiwda biynimb gunap gos kiyk key niŋbay rek, timey gi dand amey amey, Gor minim tep nuk niŋind aŋgak ak kurginiŋgamb?
Mer yimb! Biynimb gok maŋgiysek ñin gunap yesek aŋgniŋgambay; Gor nuk niŋind yimb aŋgiy, aŋgip rek gip. Minim kun ak rek Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: “Gor. Nand minim yipund giy nep apan ak, nip minim gunap pen aŋgniŋgiy rek ma ayip.
Nip kor giniŋg, kor giniŋgiy minim kiñiŋ bap ma mindeniŋgamb aŋgyak.”

content: Pen nimb aŋgniŋgambim, “Chin minek minek timey gipun rek, biynimb gunap Gor yipund giy nep gip ak miseŋ niŋiy, yimb nup dand araniŋgambay ak, chinup yenen kor giniŋgamb aŋgniŋgambim.” Pen minim kun ak, biynimb niŋiy apay rek nep aŋgniŋgambim.
Gor bi suŋ-tep biynimb maŋgiysek kor niŋniŋgamb ak, pis bap akaŋ, pis bap ma amniŋgamb; yipund giy ar ak nep aŋgniŋgamb.

Pen nimb gunap aŋgniŋgambim, “Chin yesek ar ak gon, biynimb gunap niŋiy tuŋgandikiy, Gor yipund giy nep gip ar ak niŋrep giy, yimb nup dand araniŋgambay. Kun ak yenen Gor chinup kor giy, yiwur yomb ñiniŋgamb aŋgniŋgambim.”

Minim yesek kun ak rek aŋgiy aŋgniŋgambim, “Tap siy tap timey anep gon gon; Gor minim tep ak, ap ar kun ak jimñiniŋgamb aŋgniŋgambim.” Pen biynimb gunap yip aŋgjiwyiŋg, “Pol minim kun ak rek aŋgip apay.” Minim kun ak rek yand ma apiyn! Tom gipay rek, Gor kuyip niŋind yiwur yomb ñiniŋgamb.
Biynimb Tep Bap Ma Mindpun
Kun ak yerip aŋgjun? “Gor niŋek, chin Jiwda biynimb gok mindrep gipun; biynimb yikop gok mindrep ma gipay aŋgjun?” Mer! Mey apiyn rek. Nuk niŋimb; chin maŋgiysek timey gipun.
Minim kun ak rek, Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak;

content.text: “Biynimb tep Gor kuyip dep rek gunap ma mindpay. Mer yimb!
Biynimb gos niŋrep gipay gunap ma mindpay. Biynimb ‘Gor nup chiŋgun aŋgiy’ niŋbay gunap ma mindpay.
Biynimb gok bap mindrep ma gipay. Maŋgiysek Gor nup kirgiy, mindrep ma giy, timey yimb nep gipay.

Alemb kiyk ak andik mandik giy per tom yimb nep apay ak; joŋimb kiyk ak, chip komiy yiw girep ma gey, kuyrimey wip rek ak mindip. Pen biynimb aŋgjiwiy, miluk niŋiy kunj timey giy gipay ak; ñom timey kondkol rek ak mindpay.
Kalrimey yimb jiwiy, biynimb pik ayep gos anep niŋiy,
biynimb gok kuyip per timey gey, gos kuŋay yimb nep niŋbay.
Biynimb gok yip, kapkap jimñiy mind tep giniŋgiy rek ma ayip.
Gor Biyomb ak niŋmindip aŋgiy, ma pirikpay aŋgyak.”

content: Gor aŋgek tikyak kun ak, biynimb gunap kuyip ma tikyak, chinup Jiwda biynimb per minim nup riyt giy niŋbun gok tikyak. Kun ak mind tep gipun aŋgiy ma aŋgniŋgambun. Biynimb miñmon okok maŋgiysek timey yimb gon, Gor niŋek kor gep rek nokom mindip.
Kun ak, chin Gor low minim ak niŋiy mind tep gon, biynimb suŋrep yand gok aŋgiy niŋnimuŋ rek ma ayip. Pen Gor low ak niŋiy niŋbun: chin biynimb tap siy tap timey gep gok maŋgiysek mindpun.
Krays Nup Gosimb Niŋey Mey, Biynimb Suŋ-tep Yand Aŋgip

Kun ak pen Mosis bi gok giniŋgamb aŋgiy tikiy aŋgyak rek, Jiysis Krays chinup ker kumimb ak mey; nup gosimb niŋon, Gor chinup biynimb suŋrep yand mindpim aŋgniŋgamb. Pen chin Jiwda biynimb gok sek, biynimb Jiwda mer gok sek low ar anep niŋiy gon, kun ma aŋgniŋgamb.
Biynimb mindrep yimb gipay gunap ma mindpay; maŋgiysek tap siy tap timey gipun ak, miñmon tep chinup aŋgayip ak amiy, nund yip mindenjun rek ma ayek,
Gor chinup simb niŋiy, biynimb tep yand gok maŋgiysek mindeyaŋ aŋgiy, Ñinuk Jiysis Krays nup monmon yokak.

Gor bi suŋrep, yipund giy nep gip ak; chin biynimb tap siy tap timey gipun gok, yikop dep rek ma ayak; yiwur ñinimuŋ rek nep ayak. Pen yiwur kun ak wosrey ma ñiy, mind dand amiy, yep namb won siŋbiy nep ñiniŋg, Ñinuk Krays Jiysis nup chinup ker aŋgek apiy, yiwur kun ak dek, biynimb chinup nen kumak aŋgiy gos niŋbun gok, Nop Gor biynimb suŋrep yand gok aŋgiy dip.

Kun ak low ar ak gon, chinup dek biynimb nuk mindpun aŋgiy, yimb chin key dand aranjun rek ma ayip. Jiysis chinup nen kumak gos ak niŋiy nep mey, Gor biynimb nuk mindpun. Pen chin nep tom giy aŋgniŋgambun, “Low ak niŋon, biynimb suŋ-tep yand gok aŋgniŋgamb aŋgniŋgambun.”

Kun ak, Gor chinup Jiwda biynimb gok diy; biynimb yikop gok kirgip aŋgiy, ma aŋgjun. Biyomb chin kuŋay mer. Gor nokom ak mey; chinup Jiwda biynimb gok diy, biynimb yikop gok kuyip diy gip. Jiwda biynimb gipay rek, kumbak tikey niŋiy ma dip; chin biynimb an an Jiysis chinup nen kumimb aŋgiy gos niŋon, chinup dip.

Pen Jiysis nup gosimb niŋjun apiyn ak; nimb aŋgniŋgambim, “Low minim ak kirgiyaŋ aŋgiy asap aŋgniŋgambim.” Kun aŋgiy ma apiyn. Yand apiyn ak; biynimb nup gosimb niŋbay gok, aŋgip rek giyakniŋ, low minim ak amrep yimb giniŋgamb aŋgiy apiyn.
